description: Given subtitles or timings, return the spans of dead air and how much of the runtime cutting them would save. Costs $0.002 per call — a tenth of transcription, because the expensive half is not redone. Feed it the segments transcribe_url returns.

durationSeconds.description: Total runtime in seconds. Improves the saving estimate; optional.

from_file.description: Path to a JSON file holding {segments, durationSeconds} or {vtt}. Use instead of passing them inline when there are many.

save_to.description: Optional absolute path to a NEW .json file (never overwrites; its folder must exist). Writes the full JSON result there and replies with a one-line summary — keeps long transcripts out of your context.

segments.description: Timings as [{start, end, text}] in seconds — exactly what transcribe_url returns.

vtt.description: WebVTT subtitles. Use this or segments, not both.

name: find_dead_air
title: Find the silence worth cutting
